notes_review: The calls are sound. The rewriter rightly adds no §7 gloss for "primitive accumulation", which Marx defines himself in this chapter, and trims the labor-power gloss so it does not contradict "sellers of labour" in p003. The "chevaliers d’industrie" pun is kept with literal glosses, and the economists' original-sin fable stays clearly marked as mocking paraphrase.
summary: Every claim, the irony of the original-sin fable ("Never mind!", "the present year of course always excepted") and the footnote on Italy are kept, and no attribution shifts. The §7 explanations are worked in parenthetically and the text reads plainly.
